assessments.summary: The argument establishes a bijective, sound, and complete pseudo-Boolean encoding of 154-point no-three-in-line sets in the defined rct4 subclass. Off-diagonal eligible cells decompose into disjoint four-cell rho-orbits, the eligible main-diagonal cells into 38 antipodal pairs, and the exact-selection constraints yield 38·4+2=154 cells. For each maximal lattice line, the weighted sum equals the number of selected cells on that line, so the inequalities are equivalent to the no-three-in-line condition. No external dependency is required.
scopeQualifications: The result applies only to the explicitly defined rct4 subclass of G_77.
It makes no assertion about implementation-specific constraint counts or digests, satisfiability or infeasibility, larger symmetry classes, classification of rotations, or the value of D(77).
